<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sharpened Senses](/Feats.aspx?ID=5318) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 27

**Frequency**
once per round

</column>

---

Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously. You [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301). If you use one of your senses from [Natural Senses](/Feats.aspx?ID=5302), you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.
name: Sharpened Senses
